skill.name: competitor-analysis-bot
skill.description: Analyze competitors from a provided list, then structure research into SWOT notes and gap reports.
skill.summary: Turns competitor lists into structured SWOT analysis and gap reports.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: Reviewed SKILL.md and found plain Markdown content with front matter, product description, usage notes, and review guidance. The high-entropy heuristic is a false positive caused by multilingual text and symbols, with no evidence of binary content, encrypted payloads, prompt injection, or dangerous behavior.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.23 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is human-readable Markdown with Chinese metadata, normal headings, and short usage guidance. No binary, encrypted, encoded, or hidden executable content was found.

content.value_statement: Competitive research often takes too long and produces uneven notes. This skill helps structure competitor lists, SWOT analysis, and gap reports for faster strategy review.
actual_capabilities: Uses a provided competitor list as the input for analysis.
Organizes competitor research into SWOT-style strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
Helps produce gap reports that compare market positions and product differences.
Supports conversational use without separate scripts or setup steps.
Reminds users to manually review important AI outputs before use.
limitations: The package includes guidance only, not dedicated data collection scripts.
Research quality depends on the information available to the host AI tool.
It does not independently verify competitor claims or market data.
Strategic recommendations still need human review before decisions.

use_cases.title: Compare Direct Competitors
use_cases.description: Build a structured view of strengths, weaknesses, and gaps across named competitors.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Research
use_cases.description: Create a clear competitor summary before a proposal, pitch, or advisory meeting.

use_cases.title: Review Market Position
use_cases.description: Turn scattered competitor notes into a focused gap report for planning.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Competitor Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis for a short competitor list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these competitors: [names]. Summarize their positioning, main strengths, main weaknesses, and visible product gaps.

prompt_templates.title: SWOT Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SWOT analysis for each competitor in this list: [names]. Use the same criteria for each company.

prompt_templates.title: Product Gap Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning a product roadmap or feature review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our product against these competitors: [names]. Identify feature gaps, pricing gaps, audience gaps, and positioning gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Strategy Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a competitor strategy brief for [market]. Include competitor clusters, SWOT patterns, gap priorities, risks, and recommended next research steps.

output_examples.input: Analyze three project management competitors for a small SaaS product.
output_examples.output: A competitor matrix with positioning notes, SWOT summaries, feature gaps, and recommended follow-up research.

output_examples.input: Compare our consulting service against two local agencies.
output_examples.output: A short gap report covering service scope, pricing signals, credibility markers, and possible differentiation points.

output_examples.input: Prepare a strategy brief for entering a crowded ecommerce tools market.
output_examples.output: A market-position summary with competitor groups, common weaknesses, opportunity areas, and priority questions for validation.

best_practices: Provide exact competitor names, URLs, and the market segment when possible.
Define the comparison criteria before asking for a final report.
Review important claims and numbers against trusted sources.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on the output as verified market intelligence without review.
Do not mix unrelated competitor types in one comparison without labels.
Do not ask for legal, financial, or investment conclusions from competitor notes alone.

faq.question: Does this skill collect data by itself?
faq.answer: The skill provides analysis guidance. Actual data access depends on the host AI tool and user-provided sources.

faq.question: Can it create a SWOT analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to organize competitor review into SWOT-style summaries.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is the output ready for executive decisions?
faq.answer: No. The source skill advises users to manually review key AI outputs.

faq.question: What inputs improve the analysis?
faq.answer: Competitor names, URLs, market segment, customer type, product details, and comparison criteria improve the result.

faq.question: Does it include custom scripts or integrations?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains a single Markdown skill file and no executable scripts.
